نبذة

Our friendly and competent team is here to help keep your body healthy and beautiful. We take our customers’ needs earnestly to the heart; we use only the hair products and nail polishes that are of the highest quality. We offer a range of nail, hair, and wellness services in a cosy atmosphere. We have a Russian senior stylist for nails, eyelash and hair.
